items.title: Why Oil Refiner Stocks Can Keep Gaining

items.title: Will Surging Refining Margins and Failed Marathon Talks Change Phillips 66's (PSX) Narrative?

items.title: Marathon Petroleum (MPC) is Up 121% in 2026. Is There Still More Upside?

items.title: Marathon Petroleum (MPC) Stock Looks Fairly Valued On Its 7x Five Year Run
